description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the ExamResult page of an online examination system. It manages session data, interacts with a SQL database to update and retrieve user exam information, and populates UI controls with exam results and user details.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, handling the display and update of user exam results.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page, retrieves session data, updates user exam info in database, and populates UI controls with results.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the LoginPage.
